## Example 7.4 {#iv7-example-7-4 .vector-lesson .projection-lesson .pr-compact}

```{=html}
<p>Consider the vectors in Example 7.2 which were defined as <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=5\underset{\sim}{i}-\underset{\sim}{j}"></span> and <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}=3\underset{\sim}{i}+4\underset{\sim}{j}"></span>.</p><div class="pr-cols"><div><p>a) Find the vector projection of <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}"></span> onto <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}"></span>.</p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="pr-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show solution</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}=11,\qquad |\underset{\sim}{b}|^2=25"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \operatorname{proj}_{\underset{\sim}{b}}\underset{\sim}{a}=\frac{\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}}{|\underset{\sim}{b}|^2}\underset{\sim}{b}"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle =\frac{11}{25}(3\underset{\sim}{i}+4\underset{\sim}{j})"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle =\frac{33}{25}\underset{\sim}{i}+\frac{44}{25}\underset{\sim}{j}"></span></div></div></div></div><div><p>b) Find the vector projection of <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}"></span> onto <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}"></span>.</p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="pr-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show solution</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \underset{\sim}{b}\cdot\underset{\sim}{a}=11,\qquad |\underset{\sim}{a}|^2=26"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \operatorname{proj}_{\underset{\sim}{a}}\underset{\sim}{b}=\frac{\underset{\sim}{b}\cdot\underset{\sim}{a}}{|\underset{\sim}{a}|^2}\underset{\sim}{a}"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle =\frac{11}{26}(5\underset{\sim}{i}-\underset{\sim}{j})"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle =\frac{55}{26}\underset{\sim}{i}-\frac{11}{26}\underset{\sim}{j}"></span></div></div></div></div></div>
```
